title: Screen-Time Streak

examples.explanation: Days 1 to 3 total 8 minutes and days 2 to 4 total 9. Any four days in a row add up to more than 10.
A single day with 0 minutes fits a budget of 0.

hints: Checking every start and end is O(n²). Can you reuse the work from the previous window?
All the values are non-negative. If a window is over budget, can extending it to the right ever bring it back under?
Keep two pointers. Move the right pointer forward one day at a time, and move the left pointer forward while the window is over budget. Both pointers only ever move forward.
